correctness.rationale: For exactly defined open neighborhoods, two exhaustive enumerations agree on 809 faces. Two actual, checked 256-pair free-face simplicial collapses each leave a two-complex with 16 vertices, 120 edges, 160 triangles. Contract the explicit star spanning tree, then deterministically perform 104 cellular unit relator-generator cancellations. The two independent resulting one-circle CW presentations have respectively (35 trivial,21 degree-two) and (39 trivial,17 degree-two) two-cell attaching words; subtract one degree-two attaching map from each other such map by cellular slides. Both CW models are RP^2 wedge 55 S^2. Independent boundary ranks over F2/F3/F5 and Euler check support the exact result; source verifier reconstructed and executed.

value.rationale: The naturally defined open neighborhood complex of the canonical Shrikhande strongly regular graph has genuine two-torsion and projective-plane homotopy summand, contrasting with the previously calculated sphere-wedge types of its other standard graph complexes. Complete integral homotopy rather than only Betti ranks provides a useful benchmark for torsion and graph-Hom topology, without asserting an arbitrary family extension.
